description: List all apps owned by the authenticated developer. `shared`: the apps of other developers whose team they are on (neblla_team), with their paper (`access`: partner, support, viewer, screens or staff) and what it lets them do on each area (`can`: read | write | null), and `invitations` waiting for them to accept (in the panel, «Compartido contigo»). On a shared app, use the tools its paper allows; the rest answer not_allowed.
name: neblla_list_apps
